column1: # peacockdb cost-model calibration record (#153) — BARE-cuDF source.
# Column meanings are defined in peacockdb-core/tests/common/record.rs. What is
# node_type = the cuDF entry point, not a plan node: this chain has no plan.
# node_seq = position in the hand-written chain, restarted per execute() call. The
#   benchmark runs the chain several times, so a (query, label, node_seq) has one
#   row per run and they are repeated samples, not distinct regions.
# label = load or execute. The parquet read happens once, outside the timed chain.
# peacock_host_us = 0 by construction, not by measurement. There is no host
#   prologue here to measure — that absence is the whole point of this source.
# partitions/partition = 1/0 always: one stream, no partitioning.
# cuda_bytes = the mapped call's OUTPUT bytes, under the same formula the node
